# elemento_queueaas (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento queueaas resource on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `bootstrap_servers` (String) Kafka bootstrap servers.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `is_ha` (Boolean) Whether the cluster runs in high availability.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is reachable from the public internet.
- `kafka_cert` (String, Sensitive) Kafka certificate.
- `kafka_version` (String) Kafka version.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `name` (String) Name of the queue.
- `network_uuid` (String) UUID of the private network to attach to.
- `node_number` (Number) Number of nodes.
- `node_size` (String) Size of each node.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for connections.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `size_gb` (Number) Storage size in GB.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `username` (String) Username for connections.
